items.basis: If the recirculated cooling water has low calcium carbonate hardness, the baseline rate of CaCO3 nucleation is already negligible, meaning the magnetic conditioner performs equivalently to doing nothing while biological and particulate clogging continues unabated. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "recirculated cooling water at 32-38 C" lacking specified hardness or CaCO3 saturation index

The candidate specifies a "clamp-on permanent magnet array" to act "across the supply pipe" of a "150 mm cooling-water supply line" in a "steel hot-rolling mill"; standard mill supply headers are ferromagnetic carbon steel which provides a high-permeability flux return path that shields the internal water volume, making it physically impossible for an external clamp-on array to deliver the claimed "0.9 T nominal field" across the fluid. GROUNDED_IN: COMPUTATION 0.9 T external field attenuated to near-zero inside a 150 mm ferromagnetic steel pipe due to magnetic shielding
